objects.economic_mechanism: Cumulative technological trajectories can expand feasible deployment when cost per unit of useful performance persistently falls.
objects.formula_or_reference_algorithm: Estimate a PIT robust slope of log(cost_per_performance) over time; preserve raw slope and direction state; do not convert to a scalar P score.
objects.publication_lag_rule: Use first-public timestamp for each observation; revisions become available only from their revision timestamp.
objects.normalization: Within technology family; retain raw slope plus robust standardized diagnostic.
objects.neutralization: No cross-family comparison without consistent performance-unit bridge.
known_failure_regimes: quality change not captured by performance unit
objects.missingness_policy: Return unknown when fewer than 8 comparable PIT observations exist.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; reference implementation deferred to R4

objects.economic_mechanism: Diffusion becomes structurally stronger when adoption growth itself accelerates rather than merely remaining at a high level.
objects.formula_or_reference_algorithm: Compute PIT penetration = active_adopters/eligible_population, then first and second differences over a declared window; retain level, velocity and acceleration separately.
objects.lookback: 12 months or 8 quarters, whichever is available
objects.publication_lag_rule: Use originally reported adoption and denominator vintages; do not backfill revised denominators into earlier dates.
objects.neutralization: Control for eligible-population redefinition and one-off launch effects.
objects.missingness_policy: Return unknown when eligible population is not defensibly defined.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; reference implementation deferred to R4

objects.economic_mechanism: Narrative state is better represented by marginal diffusion across independent sources than by popularity level alone.
objects.formula_or_reference_algorithm: Deduplicate sources, compute mention intensity per active source base, then PIT first and second differences; retain level/velocity/acceleration separately.
objects.publication_lag_rule: Only text timestamped and available by the observation cutoff may enter the factor.
objects.normalization: Normalize by source universe and source-specific baseline frequency.
objects.neutralization: Deduplicate syndicated copies and cap repeated mentions from a single source.
objects.missingness_policy: Return unknown when source coverage changes cannot be reconciled.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; reference implementation deferred to R4

objects.economic_mechanism: Broad source participation can exhaust marginal susceptible audiences while rising counter-narratives increase decay/reversal pressure.
objects.formula_or_reference_algorithm: Combine source saturation = active_sources/eligible_sources with PIT counter-narrative share and its velocity; report components and state, not a single weighted N score.
objects.publication_lag_rule: Use only text available by cutoff; sentiment labels must be model-version pinned.
objects.neutralization: Separate structural source growth from true saturation and maintain model-version comparability.
objects.missingness_policy: Return unknown if stance classification confidence or source-universe coverage is inadequate.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; reference implementation deferred to R4

objects.economic_mechanism: Increasing-return or superstar structures can manifest as accelerating capture of industry revenue share before long-run wealth concentration is visible.
objects.formula_or_reference_algorithm: Compute PIT company_revenue/industry_revenue and its first/second differences; preserve level and acceleration with industry-definition version pins.
objects.publication_lag_rule: Company and industry totals become usable only on their original publication dates; industry revisions are vintage-aware.
objects.normalization: Within industry definition and revenue currency basis.
objects.neutralization: Control for acquisitions, divestitures, industry reclassification and FX translation.
objects.missingness_policy: Return unknown when a stable industry denominator cannot be reconstructed PIT.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; reference implementation deferred to R4

objects.economic_mechanism: A controlled scarce bottleneck can concentrate value when demand persistently exceeds effective supply and substitution is slow.
objects.formula_or_reference_algorithm: Report PIT demand/supply tightness, persistence and substitution flags as a structured vector; no additive Xs score.
objects.publication_lag_rule: Capacity and demand estimates use their contemporaneous vintages; later restatements do not overwrite history.
objects.normalization: Within bottleneck class and physical/economic unit.
objects.neutralization: Adjust for seasonality, planned maintenance and temporary logistics shocks.
objects.missingness_policy: Return unknown when demand and effective capacity are not commensurable.
objects.reference_implementation: spec-only:R2; reference implementation deferred to R4
